purpose: Test whether an original 2011 BlackRock/iShares SOXX investment schedule can supply a historical reported-basket source before the current 2019 N-PORT history, for a possible future Stage1 breadth feature.
source_role: ASX-hosted 2011-10-31 iShares Trust N-Q original filing copy; source discovery only, not the SEC first-public record
required_checks: HTTP status and exact URL, response Date and Content-Type
exact PDF bytes, SHA-256, size, page count, and NAS archive receipt with remote hash readback
SOXX-specific October 31 2011 Schedule of Investments pages with distinguishable security, shares and value columns
report date distinguished from ASX posting date, PDF production stamp, and unverified earliest SEC publication time
no later constituent list backfilled into the 2011 training calendar
stop_conditions: If original PDF or SOXX section is missing, stop without interpreting another fund's holdings.
One 2011 report does not qualify complete 2011-2022 Stage1 training coverage; no model or account until all required vintages, securities, prices and clocks are verified.
